bucket_smartplan_desc: Personal study plans for each student, built with your own AI assistant
locked_smartplanner_title: Smart Planner is turned off for this workbook
locked_smartplanner_desc: Smart Planner turns your class marks, chapters and teacher remarks into a personal study plan for each student. You create a prompt here, paste it into any AI chat assistant you like, and bring the result back to get one PDF report per student. Student names and the school name are never put in the prompt.
smartplan_intro: Pick the tests to include, generate a prompt, run it in your own AI assistant, then upload its result to get a study-plan PDF for every student. Only student IDs ever leave StudIn - never names or the school name.
smartplan_card1_hint: A student is included if they have marks in at least one ticked test. Ticking more tests never removes anyone.
smartplan_no_tests_checked: Tick at least one test to see which students can be included.
smartplan_excluded_reason: No marks recorded for any selected test. They are left out of the prompt.
smartplan_prompt_ready: Prompt downloaded: {{fname}}. Paste it into your AI assistant, then upload its result in step 2.
smartplan_card2_title: 2. Upload the AI result and build reports
smartplan_card2_hint: Upload the file your AI assistant gives you for the prompt you just generated. If it only shows the answer in the chat, copy it and paste it into the box below instead.
smartplan_upload_need_prompt: Generate a prompt first. The result must belong to that prompt.
smartplan_err_read: The file could not be read. Please try again.
smartplan_missing: Missing from the result: {{ids}}. Regenerate or re-run the prompt before continuing.
smartplan_flagged: {{n}} student(s) had a chapter claim that did not match the logged data. Those claims are left out of their PDF.
smartplan_paste_label: Or paste the AI's answer here
smartplan_paste_placeholder: Paste the whole answer, starting with the validation code line
smartplan_rtf_converted: This was a Rich Text file; it was converted to plain text automatically.
smartplan_err_empty: Nothing to read: the file or the box is empty.
smartplan_err_unreadable: This file cannot be read as text (Word, PDF and similar files are not supported). Copy the AI's answer and paste it into the box below, or save it as a plain .txt file.
smartplan_err_no_blocks: No student results were found in this text. Check that it is the complete answer, with each student between a [[STUDENT:...]] line and a [[/STUDENT]] line.
smartplan_err_wrong_class: This result is for a different class or prompt: only {{overlap}} of the {{expected}} student IDs in your prompt appear in it. Reports are blocked. Use the result for the prompt you generated.
smartplan_confirm_missing: The validation code is missing from the top of this text, but the student IDs match your prompt. If this is the answer to the prompt you just generated, confirm to continue.
smartplan_confirm_different: The validation code in this text ({{seen}}) differs from the one in your prompt. AI assistants sometimes copy it wrongly. The student IDs match your prompt, so this is probably the right result. Confirm to continue.
smartplan_confirm_needed: Confirm the result above to build reports.
smartplan_flag_hint: You can build reports now, or re-ask your AI assistant for only these students. The re-ask prompt is small and keeps the same validation code.
smartplan_redo_ready: Re-ask prompt downloaded: {{fname}}. Run it in your AI assistant, then upload or paste its result here. Only these students will be replaced.
smartplan_redo_waiting: Waiting for the re-ask result: upload or paste it now. Only the re-asked students will be replaced.
smartplan_redone: {{n}} student(s) were replaced from the re-ask.
smartplan_issue_no_scores_cited: Scores quoted in only {{n}} of {{total}} subject notes
smartplan_issue_chapter_claim: Chapter claim does not match the data: {{chapter}}
smartplan_issue_not_in_result: Missing or incomplete in the result
smartplan_issue_wrong_language: Not written in {{language}} (only {{pct}}% of the text is)
smartplan_rail_empty: Tick a test to list the students who can be included.
